helper:
Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Note = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Note = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Note = "Empty"
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
Private Sub Grad(c As Object, a As Long, b As Long)
    c.Interior.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
    c.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
    c.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0).Color = a
    c.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1).Color = b
End Sub
Private Sub Styles(wb As Object)
    Dim t As Object
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillRed"): t.Interior.Color = 255
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillGreen"): t.Interior.Color = 65280
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillIndex"): t.Interior.ColorIndex = 6
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillTheme"): t.Interior.ThemeColor = 5: t.Interior.TintAndShade = 0.4
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillGray"): t.Interior.Pattern = xlGray50: t.Interior.PatternColor = 16711680
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillNone"): t.Interior.Pattern = xlNone
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("NoFillSet"): t.IncludePatterns = False: t.Font.Bold = True
    Set t = wb.Styles.Add("FillLight"): t.Interior.Pattern = xlLightUp
End Sub
